title: Epistemic Bias as a Means for the Automated Detection of Injustices in Text

bias_targets.methodology: A fine-tuned BERT-based tagging model utilizing expert linguistic features, a 'Too Much Information' (TMI) adjective/adverb metric, and social science lexicons to detect and classify subtle words that cause framing, testimonial, and character injustices in media text.

Using generative NLP models (CO-STAR and Social Bias Frames) paired with semantic similarity ranking (Sentence Transformers) to automatically identify, extract, and map gendered stereotypes (e.g., sexism, misogyny, women as property) associated with biased news headlines.

Applying generative models (CO-STAR and Social Bias Frames) to extract racially-charged stereotypes (e.g., racial hierarchy) from a comparative dataset of news articles analyzing media portrayals of Meghan Markle versus Kate Middleton.
